Finding: DB hardening migration not confirmed applied — anon INSERT on orders may still allow order spam via PostgREST
Impact: Forged orders bypass rate-limit/Turnstile/pricing and trigger emails
Recommendation: Run migration in dashboard; verify anon insert denied
Acceptance Criteria: anon insert/select on orders → permission denied

Finding: ORDER_WEBHOOK_SECRET committed in git history
Impact: Compromised webhook auth; forged order-email triggers
Recommendation: Rotate secret in edge fn + DB trigger
Acceptance Criteria: Old secret → 401; new order → email fires

Finding: No admin UI — EFT confirmation and order status are manual DB edits
Evidence: no /admin routes; nextadmin-template is a stub; ADMIN_SETUP_GUIDE.md stale
Impact: Every order's revenue recognition is a hand-edited row; no audit trail
Recommendation: Build minimal /admin order panel gated by admins table
Acceptance Criteria: Admin marks EFT paid via UI; audit log written; non-admin denied

Finding: Fabricated review ratings (4.6-5.0, 99-780 reviews) rendered to customers
Impact: SA CPA/ASA misleading advertising exposure; trust damage
Recommendation: Remove getPlaceholderRating rendering until real reviews exist
Acceptance Criteria: No stars/counts shown without real data

Finding: No delivery/shipping fee or zone logic — totals exclude delivery
Evidence: checkoutSchema + server-pricing.ts have no shipping concept
Impact: Under-recovered delivery cost; surprise offline quotes
Recommendation: delivery_zones table + server-resolved fee + quoted-separately fallback
Acceptance Criteria: Zone fee in total_zar; unmatched area flags order

Finding: No VAT computation or tax invoice
Evidence: no tax fields on orders/order_items; no invoice generation
Recommendation: VAT line + PDF invoice + numbering (confirm registration first)
Acceptance Criteria: Paid order produces compliant tax invoice

Finding: stock_count never decremented; qty can exceed stock (only is_sold_out checked)
Recommendation: Atomic decrement in create_order RPC or remove stock UI
Acceptance Criteria: qty>stock rejected or stock UI removed

Finding: No fulfilment lifecycle — status='completed' means paid; no scheduled/delivered states
Evidence: orders.status CHECK; ITN sets completed on payment
Impact: No status visibility post-payment; ops untracked
Recommendation: order_events + extended status enum + admin transitions
Acceptance Criteria: Status transitions persist, display, and log

Finding: No refund/cancel workflow — refunded enum values have no writer
Evidence: payment_status enum; grep: no code path
Recommendation: refunds table + admin action + email
Acceptance Criteria: Refund creates row + status transition + audit

Finding: Subscriptions and warranties account pages show hardcoded mock data
Recommendation: Remove pages or derive from order_items
Acceptance Criteria: No mock data rendered to users

Finding: Newsletter forms are dead ends — emails silently dropped
Recommendation: Persist to newsletter_subscribers + confirmation email
Acceptance Criteria: Signup row persists with consent timestamp

Finding: Email optional but email is the only persistent notification channel
Evidence: checkoutSchema email optional; edge fn skips null email
Impact: Orders orphaned if confirmation link lost
Recommendation: Require email for EFT or add order lookup by number+phone
Acceptance Criteria: Guest can recover order details without link

Finding: Deal prices on /deals never charged — checkout always uses catalog price
Evidence: deals/[slug]/page.tsx CTA → product; resolver uses products only
Impact: Advertised discount not honoured; CPA risk
Recommendation: Sync deal price to sale_price_zar or resolve deals at checkout
Acceptance Criteria: Deal price = charged price or clearly 'from' pricing

Finding: orders.items JSONB duplicates order_items — parity unenforced
Evidence: actions.ts writes both; two different readers
Impact: Confirmation page vs account history can diverge
Recommendation: Single source of truth via create_order RPC
Acceptance Criteria: One write path; readers agree

Finding: Money stored as integer ZAR — no cents possible
Recommendation: Migrate to numeric(12,2) or cents when convenient
Acceptance Criteria: Cent prices survive round-trip

Finding: Two variant systems coexist; conflicting FK cascade on parent delete
Impact: Deleting a parent may cascade or orphan — prod state unknown
Recommendation: Verify prod pg_constraint; drop dead is_base_product scheme
Acceptance Criteria: One variant scheme; documented FK behavior

Finding: Upstash rate-limit and Turnstile silently skip when env unset
Recommendation: Verify prod envs; warn loudly when disabled
Acceptance Criteria: Env matrix documented; boot warning when off

Finding: generate_lead fires for unpaid orders; no funnel events
Recommendation: Fire purchase only on paid; add view_item/add_to_cart/begin_checkout
Acceptance Criteria: Conversion events only for paid orders

Finding: Sitemap lists all 438 slugs incl. duplicate variants; categories/collections missing
Recommendation: Canonical variants→parent; add categories/collections
Acceptance Criteria: Sitemap includes all route types; variants canonical

Finding: Stale localStorage carts fail only at checkout with hard error
Impact: Poor error UX on stale carts
Recommendation: Validate cart on checkout page load; soft-fix stale items
Acceptance Criteria: Stale items flagged before submit

Finding: useCart returns silent NOOP outside provider
Recommendation: Throw or toast when provider missing
Acceptance Criteria: Failure surfaces to user

Finding: Commercial boundary overlap: chips use >=32000, filterProducts uses >=32001
Recommendation: Unify on one boundary
Acceptance Criteria: No overlap/gap at 32000

Finding: Tests re-implement functions instead of importing — no regression protection
Recommendation: Import real modules; add resolver + ITN + checkout tests
Acceptance Criteria: Breaking a real fn fails a test

Finding: Dead code: mock-data.ts, mock-products.ts, stale ADMIN_SETUP_GUIDE.md, .env.local.backup on disk, pnpm/npm ambiguity
Recommendation: Delete dead files; archive stale docs; pick pnpm
Acceptance Criteria: Clean tree; one package manager

Finding: No CSP/HSTS/X-Content-Type-Options/frame-ancestors headers
Recommendation: Add security headers
Acceptance Criteria: Headers present on all responses

Finding: misuse; no a11y testing
Recommendation: next/image everywhere; axe-core pass on PDP+checkout
Acceptance Criteria: axe clean on critical pages

Finding: No error tracking, uptime monitoring, or alerting
Impact: Silent checkout failures = silent revenue loss
Recommendation: Sentry + uptime probe + order reconciliation alert
Acceptance Criteria: Checkout error triggers alert

Finding: Checkout rate-limit uses first (spoofable) XFF hop, unlike fixed ITN route
Impact: Rate limit evadable by client-set XFF
Recommendation: Use x-real-ip/rightmost XFF same as ITN
Acceptance Criteria: Spoofed XFF doesn't reset limit

Finding: PII retention cron only covers status='submitted' orders
Recommendation: Extend retention to all terminal states
Acceptance Criteria: Old terminal orders anonymized per schedule

Finding: No post-payment confirmation email; ITN/admin-paid triggers nothing
Recommendation: Extend edge fn or trigger on paid transition
Acceptance Criteria: Paid order → customer receipt email
